scope: Source inventory extension only: four dependent email tables and 41 actual columns. No target schema, retirement decisions, runtime/version/provider/deployment change, raw rows, body/auth/provider payloads or native files.

capture_contract.field_bytes_definition: length(CAST(column AS BLOB)); includes numeric textual representation, not SQLite page occupancy
capture_contract.populated_definition: non-NULL excluding empty TEXT; JSON placeholders such as [] and {} count as populated

email_direct_retry_requests.sql:
CREATE TABLE email_direct_retry_requests (
        action_id text not null check(trim(action_id) != ''),
        attempt_number integer not null check(attempt_number > 0),
        source_readback_digest text not null check(length(source_readback_digest) = 64),
        account_configuration_snapshot text not null check(json_valid(account_configuration_snapshot))
            check(json_type(account_configuration_snapshot) = 'array')
            check(json_array_length(account_configuration_snapshot) = 9),
        requested_at text not null check(trim(requested_at) != ''),
        primary key(action_id, attempt_number),
        foreign key(action_id) references email_actions(action_id) on delete restrict
    )

triggers.name: trg_email_direct_retry_immutable_delete
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_email_direct_retry_immutable_delete
            before delete on email_direct_retry_requests
            begin select raise(abort, 'email_direct_retry_request_immutable'); end

triggers.name: trg_email_direct_retry_immutable_insert
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_email_direct_retry_immutable_insert
        before insert on email_direct_retry_requests
        when exists (select 1 from email_direct_retry_requests
                     where action_id=new.action_id and attempt_number=new.attempt_number)
        begin select raise(abort, 'email_direct_retry_request_immutable'); end

triggers.name: trg_email_direct_retry_immutable_update
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_email_direct_retry_immutable_update
            before update on email_direct_retry_requests
            begin select raise(abort, 'email_direct_retry_request_immutable'); end

email_feedback_requests.sql:
CREATE TABLE email_feedback_requests (
                    feedback_request_id text primary key
                        check(trim(feedback_request_id) != ''),
                    classification_id integer not null,
                    category text not null,
                    expected_current_action_plan_id text
                        unique
                        check(
                            expected_current_action_plan_id is null
                            or trim(expected_current_action_plan_id) != ''
                        ),
                    resulting_action_plan_id text not null unique
                        check(trim(resulting_action_plan_id) != ''),
                    applied_at text not null check(trim(applied_at) != ''),
                    check(
                        expected_current_action_plan_id is null
                        or expected_current_action_plan_id
                            != resulting_action_plan_id
                    ),
                    foreign key(classification_id)
                        references email_classifications(id) on delete restrict,
                    foreign key(expected_current_action_plan_id)
                        references email_action_plans(action_plan_id)
                        on delete restrict,
                    foreign key(resulting_action_plan_id)
                        references email_action_plans(action_plan_id)
                        on delete restrict
                )

email_reply_dispatch_claims.sql:
CREATE TABLE email_reply_dispatch_claims (
                action_identity text primary key
                    check(trim(action_identity) != ''),
                effect_digest text not null
                    check(trim(effect_digest) != ''),
                action_plan_id text not null,
                classification_id integer not null,
                account_id text not null,
                stable_message_identity text not null,
                outgoing_message_id text not null unique
                    check(trim(outgoing_message_id) != ''),
                owner_id text not null check(trim(owner_id) != ''),
                owner_generation integer not null check(owner_generation > 0),
                lease_token text not null check(trim(lease_token) != ''),
                sender text not null check(trim(sender) != ''),
                thread_identity text not null check(trim(thread_identity) != ''),
                account_updated_at text not null
                    check(trim(account_updated_at) != ''),
                account_snapshot_json text not null
                    check(json_valid(account_snapshot_json)),
                status text not null
                    check(status in (
                        'dispatching', 'retryable', 'uncertain', 'done'
                    )),
                claimed_at text not null check(trim(claimed_at) != ''),
                updated_at text not null check(trim(updated_at) != ''),
                foreign key(action_plan_id)
                    references email_action_plans(action_plan_id)
                    on delete restrict,
                foreign key(classification_id)
                    references email_classifications(id)
                    on delete restrict
            )

indexes.name: idx_email_reply_dispatch_claims_status
indexes.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_email_reply_dispatch_claims_status
            on email_reply_dispatch_claims(status, updated_at, action_identity)

email_reply_receipts.sql:
CREATE TABLE email_reply_receipts (
                action_identity text primary key
                    check(trim(action_identity) != ''),
                effect_digest text not null
                    check(trim(effect_digest) != ''),
                action_plan_id text not null,
                classification_id integer not null,
                account_id text not null,
                stable_message_identity text not null,
                outgoing_message_id text not null unique
                    check(trim(outgoing_message_id) != ''),
                provider_operation text not null
                    check(trim(provider_operation) != ''),
                provider_target text not null,
                provider_result_id text not null
                    check(trim(provider_result_id) != ''),
                provider_receipt_json text not null
                    check(json_valid(provider_receipt_json)),
                display_excerpt text not null,
                created_at text not null,
                foreign key(action_plan_id)
                    references email_action_plans(action_plan_id)
                    on delete restrict,
                foreign key(classification_id)
                    references email_classifications(id)
                    on delete restrict
            )

external_schema_references.name: trg_email_reply_dispatch_blocks_account_delete
external_schema_references.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_email_reply_dispatch_blocks_account_delete
            before delete on email_accounts
            when exists (
                select 1 from email_reply_dispatch_claims
                where account_id=old.account_id and status='dispatching'
            )
            begin
                select raise(abort, 'email_reply_dispatch_in_flight');
            end

external_schema_references.name: trg_email_reply_dispatch_blocks_plan_switch
external_schema_references.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_email_reply_dispatch_blocks_plan_switch
            before update of current_action_plan_id on email_classifications
            when old.current_action_plan_id is not new.current_action_plan_id
             and exists (
                select 1 from email_reply_dispatch_claims
                where classification_id=old.id and status='dispatching'
             )
            begin
                select raise(abort, 'email_reply_dispatch_in_flight');
            end

external_schema_references.name: trg_email_reply_dispatch_blocks_thread_update
external_schema_references.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_email_reply_dispatch_blocks_thread_update
            before update of account_id, stable_message_identity, thread_identity
            on email_messages
            when (
                old.account_id is not new.account_id
                or old.stable_message_identity is not new.stable_message_identity
                or old.thread_identity is not new.thread_identity
            ) and exists (
                select 1 from email_reply_dispatch_claims
                where account_id=old.account_id
                  and stable_message_identity=old.stable_message_identity
                  and status='dispatching'
            )
            begin
                select raise(abort, 'email_reply_dispatch_in_flight');
            end

field_inventory.meaning: Exact opaque direct-action TEXT identity, composite key with attempt_number; actual parent is email_actions.action_id.
Positive exact next attempt number, compared with current attempt_count/current+1; explicit allowance is consumed by completion or interrupted-worker recovery, never reset.

SHA256 of exact read-only source locator/revision and frozen plan/config/parameters; stored proof digest, not a copied provider body or trajectory. Existing worker eligibility uses key/config snapshot, not a new read of this proof digest.

Canonical nine-element IMAP configuration array: account_id, email_address, imap_host, imap_port, imap_username, imap_secret_reference, imap_move_mode, imap_tls, enabled. This is the real source-readback authorization snapshot, including credential reference, without credential value; release and claim compare current config.

UTC time of original explicit release; copied to email_actions.next_attempt_at/updated_at in the same transaction, not a new periodic retry policy. Retained request time checked by durable-state validation.

Stable idempotency key from the human feedback request; same key must match classification/category/expected plan; replay returns the original resulting plan. Application rejects empty/outer whitespace and >200 chars.
Exact existing classification INTEGER parent. Used to verify same human intent and hydrate original application result; not a new task identifier.
Confirmed human category decision, validated as a current category at write; stored scalar compared on same-request replay and against resulting plan during durable validation.

Nullable prior plan identity used for compare-and-set: NULL initial confirmation; processed correction requires exact current plan. UNIQUE allows multiple NULLs; non-NULL expected plan differs from result.
Exact newly persisted immutable ActionPlan identity, unique per feedback result. Replay hydrates this historical result plan rather than inventing or returning a later plan.
Original application timestamp; replay uses it for confirmed_at/updated_at presentation even when classification current plan subsequently changes.
Opaque auto_reply identity bound to account/stable message/type/plan version; nullable TEXT primary key at SQL level, while normal application writer rejects NULL/empty.
Exact accepted reply effect digest; compared to existing claim and receipt. No SQL length64 requirement here; application binds it to the effect.
Frozen authorized plan TEXT identity with actual RESTRICT FK to email_action_plans.action_plan_id; normal acquisition additionally requires it be classification current plan.
Exact classification INTEGER with RESTRICT FK to email_classifications.id; also blocks plan switching while dispatching.
Frozen account identity used for authorization joins and external account/message blocker triggers; there is no declared account FK.
Stable source message identity for account/message join and trigger matching; there is no declared message FK.
Deterministic outgoing Message-ID generated by delivery from action identity/sender domain, unique in this table; receipt matching binds exact same value.
Existing dispatch owner identity used in every mutating claim fence.
Positive existing owner generation used in every mutating claim fence; unrelated to account_updated_at.
Existing exact lease token used in CAS; not a public receipt ID or authorization body.
Authorized sender compared to current account email_address and to accepted effect; retained in claim snapshot.
Frozen thread identity compared with current message/effect; external thread blocker prevents dispatch-time changes.
Account version timestamp captured at acquisition/reacquisition; live account version checked before release retryable.

Actual full _account_row dictionary snapshot, including transport/settings and credential references, not credential values. Delivery reconstructs EmailReplyAccount from claim.account_snapshot. This is configuration/authorization input needed by existing dispatch path, not a raw task/trajectory copy; no snapshot contents captured here.

Existing dispatching/retryable/uncertain/done state. Release permits retry only after authorization checks; possible dispatch/terminated owner becomes uncertain; matching receipt completes claim. Empty table is not dead-path proof.
Acquisition timestamp, refreshed on retryable reacquisition; _email_reply_dispatch_claim_row exposes it.

Current state/owner update timestamp set on acquisition/reacquisition, uncertainty, retryable release, terminated-owner recovery and receipt completion. Status index includes updated_at/action_identity.
Opaque automatic reply identity: lookup/replay receipt prevents another delivery; nullable TEXT primary key at SQL level although application writer rejects NULL/empty.
Exact accepted effect digest compared for receipt conflict and matching claim completion. SQL only requires trimmed nonempty, not fixed digest length.
Exact frozen plan TEXT identity with RESTRICT FK to email_action_plans.action_plan_id; durable validation checks its action/account/classification binding.
Exact classification INTEGER with RESTRICT FK to email_classifications.id; observability lookup and binding validation.
Frozen account identity for receipt/message context and plan binding; no declared account FK.
Frozen source message identity for context projection/plan binding; no declared message FK.
Unique opaque outgoing Message-ID matching deterministic dispatch/Sent query; receipt replay and existing claim must agree.
Actual verified Sent operation, application writer allows sent_readback or sent_equivalent_readback; SQL only requires nonempty and does not enumerate these operations.
Opaque target identity; delivery passes source stable_message_identity. Not recipient body; application validates opacity/credentials. SQL itself permits empty TEXT because no trim check.
Opaque verified Sent result identifier; also projected as receipt_id for context and observability.

Existing four-key Sent evidence dictionary: sent_folder, sent_uidvalidity, sent_uid, smtp_acceptance_id. SMTP acceptance alone is insufficient; application requires positive Sent coordinates and matching query. Replay may enrich only empty SMTP acceptance ID, preserving other evidence; raw email body/trajectory is absent.
Existing fixed business-facing successful verification summary generated by persist_email_reply_receipt, not a copied reply body; context/observability project it.
Original receipt creation timestamp, preserved on replay/enrichment; used for context/observability ordering. SQL has no default/nonempty check.

limitations: Single read transaction captures metadata/aggregate values only, not durable row correctness or provider outcomes.

Empty reply claims/receipts at capture do not prove dead code. Existing methods and delivery-module call paths are mapped; current documented SMTP/auto_reply disablement is distinct from API existence.

Table column_declaration_sha256 hashes ordered table_xinfo; per-field source_column_sha256 hashes exact column xinfo plus declaration tokens and table name. These are source schema hashes, not raw values or historical trajectory contents.
No target fields, retirements, migrations, version reservations, constructor activation or deployment are proposed.

bounded_navigation.method: Literal table/API symbol searches in app followed by direct source verification; AST line/owner index over eleven named caller/DDL modules only. No broad repository graph needed for the now explicit call paths.

direct_retry.existing_behavior: Direct retry request immutable after insert; normal worker uses key/current config and consumes exactly the scheduled next attempt. source_readback_digest is historical proof; no provider readback or authorization values exported.

feedback.existing_behavior: Same feedback ID must match prior intent and returns historical result; new correction binds exact expected current plan. confirm_classification and correct_training_label are existing wrappers; no external app caller to correct_training_label found in exact symbol scan.

reply.existing_behavior: Existing delivery module supports owner-fenced claims, uncertain/retryable outcomes and Sent evidence replay. Current documented SMTP/auto_reply disablement and category config rejection are distinct from these surviving APIs; no production send invoked or inferred.

receipt_projection.existing_behavior: Context source and worker use redacted receipt summaries; classification observability exposes safe result fields without target/payload.

validation.coverage: All four tables/41 fields, exact prior actual/fresh declarations and object equality, xinfo+column/check/unique/FK/null/default hashes, storage/population/byte aggregates, sequences and inbound trigger/FK closure; every mapped writer/reader path bound to actual function+line/source hash.
